title: Wayfare Driver Agreements: Cancellation Standard Schedule
content:
Every service level of the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product carries its own cancellation standard. The schedule lists each figure for the six Wayfare levels.

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cancellation rate threshold (percent) | 10.00 | 10.00 | 8.00 | 8.00 | 6.00 | 6.00 |
| Accepted trips over which the rate is computed | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Cancellations left out of the rate | rider no-show marked; safety concern reported; rider requested cancellation in chat | same three | same three | same three | same three | same three |
| Cancellation warnings before a further breach leads to a hold | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Temporary hold length (calendar days) | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Breaches in the lookback that lead to deactivation | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Breach lookback (calendar days) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Warning validity (calendar days) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Action on acceptance rate | none | none | none | none | none | none |

## Notes

- **Threshold**: the driver cancellation rate above which the cancellation standard acts, in percent. The cancellation rate threshold of the level is 10.00 on Wayfare Standard and Wayfare Green, 8.00 on Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare XL, and 6.00 on Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV.
- **Cancellations left out**: a driver cancellation marked as a rider no-show, one where a safety concern was reported, and one the rider requested in chat do not count toward the rate.
- **Temporary hold**: the length of a hold for a repeated cancellation-rate breach.
- **Lookback**: the calendar days over which cancellation-rate breaches are counted.
- **Warning validity**: a warning older than 90 calendar days no longer counts toward escalation.
- **Acceptance rate**: the acceptance rate never leads to a warning, hold, downgrade or deactivation; drivers are free to decline requests.

## Hypothetical comparison

A hypothetical driver cancellation rate of 8.0 percent is not above the 8.00 threshold of Wayfare Comfort; a rate of 8.1 percent is above it. The same 8.1 percent is above the 6.00 threshold of Wayfare Black and not above the 10.00 threshold of Wayfare Standard.
